repos_data.description: The free, open-source meeting-notes app for your Mac — offline transcription and AI notes, free in the cloud or 100% on-device.
A local LLM workhorse that keeps a memory of your workday. On-device meeting notes, dictation, autocomplete, and recall for macOS. GPLv3.

repo_meta_data.description: Free, open-source AI autocomplete for macOS — on-device ghost-text suggestions in every app. A private, local Cotypist alternative built with MLX.
